segments.ja157:1.1: Yena kāmaṃ paṇāmeti, dhammo balavataṃ migī;
segments.ja157:2.1: Api cepi dubbalo mitto, mittadhammesu tiṭṭhati;
segments.ja157:2.3: So ñātako ca bandhu ca, so mitto so ca me sakhā;
segments.ja157:2.5: Dāṭhini mātimaññittho [maññivo (syā.), maññavho (ka.)], siṅgālo mama pāṇadoti.
